title: crataegus macrosperma var. acutiloba
intro: Crataegus macrosperma var. acutiloba, commonly known as the Chinese hawthorn, is a variety of the hawthorn plant, a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China and other parts of Asia. The health benefits of Chinese hawthorn include its ability to support cardiovascular health, lower blood pressure, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Chinese hawthorn include its use as a cardiotonic, diuretic, and antispasmodic, making it useful in treating conditions such as angina, hypertension, and irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of Chinese hawthorn include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
